name: VelvetSkyline
source:
Kaelen Vance was once the best crisis manager in the business—the man who could spin any scandal, bury any secret, and make the powerful look like saints. That was before one mistake destroyed his career, his firm, and his fiancée in a single spectacular collapse.

Now, drowning in debt and desperate for a second chance, he receives an unexpected offer from Victoria Sterling—the ice-cold CEO of Sterling Hospitality. Her empire is crumbling from within, her enemies are circling, and she needs someone with nothing left to lose.

But as Kaelen digs deeper into the glittering world of corporate hospitality, he crosses paths with Nyx—a fiery street artist waging war against the very empire he's been hired to protect. She sees through every lie he's ever told, challenges every belief he's ever held, and makes him question which side he's really on.

Two women. Two worlds. One impossible choice.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4449340/]Steam[/url]]
